lab.quote: You see, when a company sack 2,000 and hires 2,000, what shows up to you is net addition zero. But they've actually hired 2,000, and for that hiring, they will use us. What is happening is you're letting go of one skill set and hiring another skill set, because the demands of clients are changing. If you are shifting base towards IT-oriented or AI-oriented sort of hiring, you will hire some people and you'll fire some people. Net could be zero. For hiring of people, you will still use us.

What is happening is you're letting go of one skill set and hiring another skill set, because the demands of clients are changing. If you are shifting base towards IT-oriented or AI-oriented sort of hiring, you will hire some people and you'll fire some people. Net could be zero. For hiring of people, you will still use us.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: When a company fires 2,000 and hires 2,000, the net addition is zero, but the company still uses them for the hiring part because they are a hiring business, not a firing business.

Subsidiary SIHL agreed to invest ₹5 Cr in Bizcrum Infotech (Bijnis) via Series B2 CCPS, taking its stake to 20.12%.
Recruitment billings grew 12.6% in Q2FY27 with AI billings contributing an annualized run rate of around ₹240 Cr.
Board approved investment of up to ₹150 Cr in wholly owned subsidiary Redstart Labs (India) Limited over 18 months.
Board approved divestment of 14.18% stake in Medcords Healthcare and 31.64% stake in Unnati Online for nominal consideration of ~₹5,000 each (both fully impaired previously).
Hitesh Oberoi transitioning to Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director role from December 3, 2026.
Sanjeev Bikhchandani's term as Group CEO set until April 26, 2031.
AI and data products annualized run-rate billings stood at ~₹240 Cr as of Q2FY27.
Job Hai annual cash burn stands at ~₹45 Cr, with breakeven targeted at ₹100-125 Cr revenue.
Investment portfolio spans ~135 companies across AI, deeptech, and consumer tech with ~₹5,000 Cr invested.

timeline.summary: Info Edge approved a ₹5 Cr investment in its wholly-owned subsidiary Startup Investments (Holding) Limited via CCDs.
2026-05-18: Info Edge approved ₹30 Cr investment in subsidiary SIHL via CCDs
2026-05-19: Info Edge files appeal before NCLAT against NCLT's April 7 order directing creditor meetings for amalgamation scheme
2026-05-22: Info Edge reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue up 17.2% YoY to ₹805 Cr with operating margin at 40.1%, and recommended a ₹3.60 final dividend.
Info Edge published the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 22, 2026.
Info Edge (India) Limited’s **Mr. Vineet Ranjan** to attend one-on-one meetings with Tata Mutual Fund, UTI Mutual Fund, and Renaissance Investment Managers on June 3, 2026, in Mumbai.

Info Edge (India) Limited’s **Jaya Bhatia** scheduled one-on-one meetings with **Millennium Partners** (June 5, 2026, virtual) and **Janchor Partners** (June 12, 2026, Noida) led by **Mr. Vineet Ranjan** and **Mr. Hitesh Oberoi** under SEBI’s Listing Regulations.
Info Edge approved a ₹200 Cr investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries SISL and SIHL.
Info Edge announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Redstart Labs will exit its 13.38% stake in Psila Tech through a capital reduction.
Info Edge approved a ₹5 Cr primary investment through its subsidiary SIHL in Bizcrum Infotech (Bijnis) for a 20.12% fully diluted stake.
Info Edge (India) Limited declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 3 per equity share effective October 28, 2026.
Info Edge reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹842 Cr, up 12.8% YoY, and declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per share.
Info Edge approved a ₹150 Cr investment in Redstart Labs and divested legacy impaired stakes in Medcords and Unnati Online for nominal amounts.
Hitesh Oberoi to step down as MD & CEO on December 2, 2026, with founder Sanjeev Bikhchandani assuming the Group CEO role.
Info Edge (India) Limited held a Q2 FY 2026-27 Post Result Conference Call on 28 Oct 2026 at 04:00 PM IST.
Info Edge Q2FY27 call: AI ARR reached ₹240 Cr, 99acres neared breakeven, and Sanjeev Bikhchandani was confirmed to succeed Hitesh Oberoi as Group CEO.
